statements.t: We anticipate this achievement will result in reduced interest expense, improved access to capital markets, and enhanced liquidity, among other benefits.

We funded our capital expenditures for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, entirely from cash flows from operations, and we expect to fund the remainder of our 2026 capital expenditures budget entirely from cash flows from operations given our anticipated level of oil and gas production, current commodity prices and our commodity hedge positions in place.
We plan to return capital to shareholders primarily through our base dividend, in addition to opportunistic share repurchases.
Additionally, our recently achieved investment grade credit ratings from each of S&P, Moody’s and Fitch are expected to further support our access to the debt capital markets at favorable terms.

statements.t: “As a result of our team's relentless focus on driving higher free cash flow, our current plan is expected to generate an incremental $300 million of free cash flow this year compared to our original plan in February, normalized for commodity prices.
